_meta.indication: Mozobil, a hematopoietic stem cell mobilizer, is indicated in combination with G-CSF to mobilize hematopoietic stem cells to the peripheral blood for collection and subsequent autologous transplantation in patients with non-Hodgkin's lymphoma and multiple myeloma

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study 3101 (AMD3100-3101), the randomized placebo-controlled trial in NHL patients
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of G-CSF/plerixafor versus G-CSF plus placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with non-Hodgkin's lymphoma planning autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Collection of ≥ 5 × 10^6 CD34+ cells/kg within 4 or fewer apheresis days
pivotal_trials.result: 59% (89/150) of Mozobil+G-CSF patients collected ≥ 5×10^6 CD34+ cells/kg in ≤4 apheresis days vs 20% (29/148) with placebo+G-CSF (p < 0.001)

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study 3102 (AMD3100-3102), the randomized placebo-controlled trial in multiple myeloma patients
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of G-CSF/plerixafor versus G-CSF/placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with multiple myeloma planning autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Collection of a total of ≥ 6 × 10^6 CD34+ cells/kg within two apheresis days
pivotal_trials.result: 72% (106/148) of Mozobil+G-CSF patients collected ≥ 6×10^6 CD34+ cells/kg in ≤2 apheresis days vs 34% (53/154) with placebo+G-CSF (p < 0.001)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%) more frequent than placebo during HSC mobilization/apheresis were diarrhea (37%), nausea (34%), fatigue (27%), injection site reactions (34%), headache (22%), arthralgia (13%), dizziness (11%) and vomiting (10%); warnings include potential tumor cell mobilization, increased leukocytes/decreased platelets, and potential splenic enlargement
target_moa: Plerixafor is an inhibitor of the CXCR4 chemokine receptor and blocks binding of its ligand SDF-1α; CXCR4 and SDF-1α play a role in homing of hematopoietic stem cells to the marrow, so inhibition mobilizes HSCs into peripheral blood

advisory_committee.vote: This application was not taken to an Advisory Committee because the efficacy results were clinically and statistically robust and the safety profile was acceptable

orphan_indication.text: Mozobil has orphan drug designation/exclusivity for these indications (NHL and MM stem cell mobilization)
